findings.claim: Excluding the whole tip of an upstream of another name drops the branch own commits once that upstream holds them: a branch pushed with git push -u origin HEAD:other, or a child fast-forwarded or merged into its parent, is asked nothing.
evidence: upstreamTip returned the tip whenever branch.<b>.merge is refs/heads/<x> with x != b, and Standing added ^<tip>.
Fixed in ad9e5e4e (L153): local upstream only, exclude up to merge-base, ask as before when the tip holds HEAD.
